justification: LOINC 51244 represents forced expiratory volume in 1 second (FEV1) as a percentage of predicted, and a value of 22.5% indicates severe airflow obstruction (GOLD stage 4 COPD) which, while survivable, represents a critically compromised respiratory state that would typically warrant urgent clinical intervention and is at the extreme lower boundary of physiological plausibility for an ambulatory patient.
